notes.notes:

Reanimated gargoyles have swarmed the cities, controlled by the Dark Lord himself. A vampire, we thought has been defeated forever. War with the darkness has begun and our only option is to fight until our last breath.

Finally, there are Dragons in Emporea!

The event lasts 6 days. Players' job is to raid the event camps in order to look for "Dragon chests". Dragon chests contain many treasures, including  4 kinds of Ice coin parts. 1 of each kind is needed to create an Ice coin in the Forge. notes.title: Patch 4.77 is here with the new ‘Arachnophobia’ event!
notes.notes:
Arachnophobia  

That which many feared, has become a reality. Swarms of spiders started to slaughter everything living around their hatcheries. There isn't much time, we have to get the situation under control and protect our supplies. Hero, gather your best warriors and prepare for extermination.

The event lasts 6 days. The player has to raid neutral event camps in order to obtain the Spider Eggs – the currency of the event. The Eggs are used to purchase special artifacts, units and a spell in the Event shop.  

Event Camps

Egg Brooder

Medium camp (31-40 level)
2 Command Points needed to attack
Neutral units: Acolyte, Arachnid
Loot: 
A 66% chance to get 1x Spider Egg
Chance to find a Rune of Earth (II)
Gain 1,7x more resources and experience points
Random resource type 

Spider Nest

Hard camp (41-60 level)
3 Command Points needed to attack
Neutral units: Acolyte, Arachnid
Loot:
A 100% chance to get 1x Spider Egg
Chance to find a Rune of Water (III) (Only if this rune is available in the game world. Until then, Rune of Earth (II) can be found in the Egg Brooder.)
Gain 2,5x more resources and experience points
Random resource type 

Event Items

Spider Egg – the currency needed for buying items in the Event shop. Can be gained by attacking the neutral event camps (Egg Brooder, Spider Nest) and also by attacking the Easy Portal (5% chance), Medium Portal (7% chance), Hard Portal (9% chance) and Very Hard Portal (11% chance). It can also be created at the Alchemist.

Spider Queen item – can be used to summon the Spider Queen unit to your army. 


Event Units 

Spider Queen 
Can be obtained in the Event Shop for 30 Spider Eggs and costs 4000 gold and 4000 iron to be recruited.
Stats: 
Upkeep – 180
Damage  –  5500 (normal)
HP – 10 000
Resistance – 20 (normal)
Regeneration – 20 

Special abilities:

Immortality – after the unit dies in battle, it reappears in the inventory and can be recruited again for 4000 gold and 4000 iron.
Breeding – If the Spider Queen survives until the end of the battle, it will put one Exploder into the player’s army (the player has to have free Upkeep for the Exploder to be added to his army).

Exploder
Cannot be purchased and can only be created by the Spider Queen. 
Stats: 
Upkeep – 25
Damage  –  2000 (fire)
HP – 20
Resistance – 1 (fire)
Regeneration – 0 

Special abilities:

Explode – The unit will always die at the end of the first round (it will explode) and cannot  be regenerated. 

Event Artifacts

Heavy Crossbow (legendary artifact)
Features: 
Damage: +7% (+7% with each additional level)
HP: +3% (+3% with each additional level)
Multiresistance: +6% (+4% with each additional level) 

Mask of Silence (legendary helmet)
Features: 
Spell recovery: +8% (+6% with each additional level)
Magic damage: +9% (+6% with each additional level)
Effect of spells cast on you: +10% (+5% with each additional level) 

Weight of the World (rare boots)
Features: 
Building speed: +5% (+3% with each additional level)
Building cost: -4% (-3% with each additional level) 

Deadly Premonition (rare belt) 
Features: 
Spell damage on neutral units: +6% (+5% with each additional level)
Experience bonus: +3% (+3% with each additional level) 

Shoulder of Wisdom (rare shoulder armor)
Features: 
Experience bonus: +6% (+3% with each additional level)
Artifact discovery: +4% (+2% with each additional level)  

Event Spells

Spider Swarm
Features: 
Damage – 33 000 (normal, +15 000 with each additional level)
Mana cost – 300 (+30 with each additional level)
Cooldown – 7200 seconds (-1000 seconds with each additional level)
Range – 60 (+5 with each additional level) 

You can read all about the event here: http://emporea.wikia.com/wiki/Arachnophobia

Other changes and improvements in the game:
 
New achievement – Daily Quests (Finish “x” daily quests).
Some achievement conditions have changed.
Other minor improvements and bug fixes.

“Gates of the Underworld”  event is back

Gates of the Underworld, guarded by the powerful Chimera, are suddenly in danger. Greedy heroes longing for rare artifacts have no idea what awaits them on the other side. History repeats itself, and many have probably forgotten why these doors should be closed forever!

The event lasts 6 days. The player has to raid the Event Camps in order to obtain Parts of the Triangle. After combining the three parts a Triangle will be created – the event’s currency. The Triangle is used to obtain items in the Event shop (runes, artifacts, spells).

In the Extreme Camps (Wrested balcony), the player can obtain one Chimera head (lion, snake, goat). Combining them will create the powerful Chimera unit.

Changes made to the event:
Some quests have been slightly modified or rearranged.
Additional artifacts have been added to the Event Shop

You can read all about the event here: http://emporea.wikia.com/wiki/Gates_of_the_Underworld


Other changes and improvements in the game:
A new special mini event is launching next week. More information coming soon, but here’s a small teaser! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/890208562a1541d77beba3e215bf69622b47dfac.png

When all of your architects are busy and you try to use another one, a window with an overview of all your building upgrades in progress will be shown. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/a1e6201ae4512cb92225d22c2e0f70031ab3b922.png

Prices of the purchased and sold items in the Marketplace are now shown in the Market log without the tax.
Several problems with battles and notifications have been repaired. 
Other minor changes and improvements.

notes.title: Patch 4.71 is here with the new ‘Lord of Darkness’ event and Hecate!
notes.notes:
Lord of Darkness

Reanimated gargoyles have swarmed the cities, controlled by the Dark Lord himself. A vampire, we thought has been defeated forever. War with the darkness has begun and our only option is to fight until our last breath.

The event lasts 6 days. The player has to raid the Event Camps in order to obtain Coffin Keys. They are used to open randomly generated Coffins which contain various items, but most notably, parts of the Ancient Relic. Forging these parts together will create a complete Ancient Relic (the event’s currency) used to obtain items in the Event shop (runes, artifacts and units). 

Event Camps

Graveyard
Medium camp (31-40 level)
2 Command Points needed to attack
Neutral units: Necromancer, Succubus
Loot:
A 66% chance to get 1x Coffin Key
Chance to find a Rune of Earth (II)
Gain 1,7x more resources and experience points
Random resource type

Dark Castle
Hard camp (41-60 level)
3 Command Points needed to attack
Neutral units: Necromancer, Succubus
Loot:
A 100% chance to get 1x Coffin Key
Chance to find a Rune of Water (III) (Only if this rune is available in the game world. Until then, Rune of Earth (II) can be found in the Dark Castle.)
Gain 2,5x more resources and experience points
Random resource type


Event Items

Parts of the Ancient Relic (I,II,III) – forge these three parts together to get a whole Ancient Relic.

Ancient Relic – the currency needed for buying items in the Event shop. Can be created by forging all three Parts of the Ancient Relic.

Coffin Key – is used to open Coffins. You can also gain them by attacking the Easy Portal (5% chance), Medium Portal (7% chance), Hard Portal (9% chance) and Very Hard Portal (11% chance). It can also be created at the Alchemist.

Gargoyle item – use to add a Gargoyle unit to your army.

Lord of Darkness item – use to add a Lord of Darkness unit to your army.

Three types of Coffins –
Wooden Coffin: 2 keys needed to open and contains:
3 to 9 Ancient Relic Parts
25% Chance to get 1x Gargoyle
1 Gem
20 Experience Points
30 mana

Robust Coffin: 4 keys needed to open and contains:
9 to 18 Ancient Relic parts
50% chance to get 1x Gargoyle
3-5 random ingredients
1x random potion (level 1)
3x 20 Experience Points
100 mana

Luxury Coffin: 15 keys needed to open and contains:
36 to 60 Ancient Relic parts
3x Gargoyle
1x Lord of Darkness
3x Arena ticket
1x random potion (level 4)
300 mana


Event Units

Gargoyle 
Can be obtained in the Event Shop for 1000 stone or by opening the Coffins. It cannot be purchased after the event is over.
Stats:
Upkeep – 10
Damage  –  1000 (cold)
HP – 5000
Resistance – 35 (normal)
Regeneration – 33
Special abilities:
Provoke – the Gargoyle is guarding other units in battle, by attracting 10x more damage.

Lord of Darkness
Can be obtained in the Event Shop for 20 Ancient Relics or by opening the Luxury Coffins. 
Stats:
Upkeep – 125
Damage  –  4500 (normal)
HP – 7000
Resistance – 20 (cold)
Regeneration – 25
Special abilities:
Vampirism – decreases enemy unit HP by 30%
Immortality – after the unit dies in battle, it reappears in the inventory and can be recruited again for 5000 wood and 5000 gold.
 
 
Event Artifacts

Weight of the World (rare boots)
Features:
Building speed: +5% (+3% with each additional level)
Building cost: -4% (-3% with each additional level)


Deadly Premonition (rare belt)
Features:
Spell damage on neutral units: +6% (+5% with each additional level)
Experience bonus: +3% (+3% with each additional level)


Ring of Fire (legendary ring)
Features:
Damage: +4% (+4% with each additional level)
Regeneration: +2% (+2% with each additional level)
Fire resistance: +6 (+6 with each additional level)


Bloodline Chalice (legendary artifact)
Features:
Damage: +7% (+4% with each additional level)
Experience bonus: +5% (+5% with each additional level)
Artifact discovery: +4% (+3% with each additional level)

You can read all additional information about the event, quests and shop here: http://emporea.wikia.com/wiki/Lord_of_Darkness



http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/95872639154a0a33287c34045a8af2a0903cee7d.png

Hecate game world returns!

Welcome Sorcerer, to a realm where untamed magical energies run rampant and torrents of mana swirl across the starry sky.  Welcome to the source of magic itself!  

Hecate is a special server for experienced players. It is faster and it concentrates on magic.   

How much “faster” is it? Hecate lasts only 28 days, which is 3,5 times less than all the regular servers. Moreover, most game actions are 3 times faster than on usual game worlds!   

How does it “concentrate on Magic”? In Hecate magic skills are much more powerful, ALL spells are stronger and have unlimited range. Summoning spells conjure much more units and Magic pollution dissipates rapidly. Players collect Magic Essence - which serves as a crafting material for magical artifacts - and Magical Stones - which are used to research NEW spells. Moreover players start with a free mana totem. 

You can now register to the game world and it starts on October 27th, 2016 at 10:00 Emporea time. 



Other changes and improvements in the game:

The leader of an alliance or the player with the rights to do so, can now create a Non-aggression pact. If a player attacks a fortress or a city of a friendly alliance, he will get a warning, which tells him that the pact is active and should not attack. The pact can be activated by opening the information about the other alliance.
We’ve added a notification sound when a mass attack has been created.
Several problems with battles and notifications have been resolved.
Other minor changes and improvements.

We’re looking forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Patch 4.70 is here!
notes.notes:
The "Eye of the Beholder" event is back!

Creatures from the depth of the oceans decided to pay a visit to the surface of Emporea!

The event lasts 6 days. Player’s job is to raid the event camps (and portals) in order to collect 4 kinds of Pearls, the basic currency of the event necessary for creating of a Pearl amulet, which is used for obtaining of all other event items and objects.

Pearl amulet can also be crafted at the Alchemist.

You can read all about the event here: http://emporea.wikia.com/wiki/Eye_of_the_Beholder


Changes and improvements in the game:
The Magic Laboratory spell research window has been redesigned for better clarity and usability.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/2dc6fdc275a6bf1483d16120cdfb0b7f1df18ad2.png


Players will be rewarded for speeding up the building, recruitment, mana production or research of your alliance teammates with experience points. When a player looks at a teammate’s city, there will be a blue progress bar visible. After the goal is finished and the bar is full, the player will be rewarded with the experience points and a new progress bar will appear. More speed ups will be needed than in the previous one. This progress resets every 24 hours and starts from the beginning. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/9a3fbc66917697e729951942752822e07cd1ad42.png


We added a new achievement: Play every day! - Login in one game world each day for at least 2/7/20/50/95 times (depending on the level of the achievement).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/0838b85794a16b72496b661ee45e063c0e0e19a6.png


Other minor changes and bug fixes.

notes.title: New PATCH 4.69
notes.notes:
"Sands of Oblivion" Event is back!

There are Ifrits, Djinns and Magical lamps in Emporea! Also, a great part of the world map gets covered by sand tiles and palm trees. (Therefore we can assume that long drinks and beach bars are somewhere to be found too).

The event lasts for 6 days. Player’s job is to earn "Points" by raiding the event camps, sending alchemist ingredients & with friendly buildings speed-ups in order to collect "Magical lamp." (1000 Points = 1 Magical lamp).

The Magical lamp is the event basic "currency", necessary for obtaining other event items and objects (artifacts, units, spell) in the event Shop.

Ifrits cost mana (!), and they can be bought for 400 mana each in the event Shop, but only during the event.

You can read more about the event here: http://emporea.wikia.com/wiki/Sands_of_Oblivion



Other changes and improvements in the game:

The achievements have been redesigned and from now on, players will be rewarded with gems for completing them. The gems for the completion will be added to your inventory. All players with already completed achievements will be retroactively rewarded with gems, which will be added to their global inventory (rewards).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/bd68d9f05bd13aca2adeca7ce3c6fdf5dfdd74e7.png


Special abilities of units have more detailed descriptions.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/f1362764fcadb559c3d98fb0ecf0318a9e498e24.png


The windows shown after opening a chest have been redesigned and have a new layout and picture.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/98252e7a8f09f7fd6f3c04adf52e7a2c10fc846b.png


The battle report windows have also been redesigned. Now, they also include information about the total killed upkeep, total lost upkeep and the best fighter from both sides of the battle.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/16352891/1a6d9ce96f0b9015cb86db4b01a7cad0987009f6.png


The names of alliances have been restricted to maximum 25 characters.

All forgotten gems from the player’s inventory will be automatically added to the overall amount after the end of the game world.

notes.title: PATCH 4.61 and the new “Gates of the Underworld” event are here!
notes.notes:
Gates of the Underworld

Gates of the Underworld, guarded by the powerful Chimera, are suddenly in danger. Greedy heroes longing for rare artifacts have no idea what awaits them on the other side. History repeats itself, and many have probably forgotten why these doors should be closed forever! 

The event lasts 6 days. The player has to raid the Event Camps in order to obtain Parts of the Triangle. After combining the three parts a Triangle will be created – the event’s currency. The Triangle is used to obtain items in the Event shop (runes, artifacts, spells).

In the Extreme Camps (Wrested balcony), the player can obtain one Chimera head (lion, snake, goat). Combining them will create the powerful Chimera unit. 


Event Camps

Asylum 
Medium camp (31-40 level)
2 Command Points needed to attack
Neutral units: Flamekin, Frostguard
Loot: 
A 66% chance to find a part of the Triangle
Chance to find a Rune of Earth (II)
Gain 1,7x more resources and experience points
Random resource type

Sleeping volcano
Hard camp (41-60 level)
3 Command Points needed to attack
Neutral units: Flamekin, Frostguard, Changeling
Loot: 
A 100% chance to find a part of the Triangle
Chance to find a Rune of Water (III) (Only if this rune is available in the game world. Until then, Rune of Earth (II) can be found in Volcanoes.)
Gain 2,5x more resources and experience points
Random resource type

Wrested balcony
Extreme camp (undetermined level)
5 Command Points needed to attack
Neutral units: Frostguard, Flamekin, Chimera
Loot: 
A 150% chance to find a part of the Triangle
Is available for raiding using Mass Attack - AT LEAST 5 WARRIORS NEEDED for 1 of them to get one of the Heads of Chimera (Head of the Goat, Head of the Lion, Head of the Snake)!
Gain 5x more resources and experience point
Chance to find any Rune (highest Rune currently available in the game world)
Random resource type
 

Event Items

Parts of the Triangle (I,II,III) - Get all three parts to create the Triangle – currency that allows you to buy items in the event shop. You can also gain them by attacking the Easy Portal (5% chance), Medium Portal (7% chance), Hard Portal (9% chance) and Very Hard Portal (11% chance).

Triangle - The currency needed for buying items in the Event shop. Can be created by forging all three Parts of the Triangle. It can also be created at the Alchemist.

Heads of the Chimera (Head of the Snake, Head of the Lion, Head of the Goat) - After finding and combining these three heads, you will gain the Chimera unit.

Chimera unit - Use to add the Chimera to your army. 
 

Event Units

Chimera
Summons by  combining  all the Heads (lion, snake, goat) and using it.

Chimera stats:
Upkeep – 200
Damage  – 10 500 (chaos)
HP – 8000
Resistance – 30 (fire)
Regeneration – 15

Special abilities:
Chaos damage – no damage reduction by opponent’s protection
Immortality – after being defeated in a battle, Chimera reappears in your inventory and can be reborn by spending 3 runes


Event Artifacts

Song of the night (common ring)
Features:
Iron production +3 % (+3% with each additional level)
Resource production +2 % (+2 % with each additional level)

Sash of knives (rare belt)
Features:
HP bonus +4 % (+2 %)
Experience bonus +2 % (+2 % with each additional level)

Magic collar (legendary shoulder)
Features:
Magic damage + 5 % (+ 3 % with each additional level)
Reach of spell + 8 % (+5 %)
Mana production + 5 % (+ 3 %)


Event Spells

Chaos grip
Features:
Damage – 40 000 (chaos, +10 000 with each additional level)
Mana cost – 400 (+25 with each additional level)
Cooldown – 7200 seconds (-1000 seconds with each additional level)
Range – 50 (+5 with each additional level)

You can read all additional information about the event, quests and shop here: http://emporea.wikia.com/wiki/Gates_of_the_Underworld

New hero slot has been added - belts! Two new common belts can be found by raiding the neutral camps.

Several new Reward chests for finishing a game world have been added.

notes.title: PATCH 4.59 is here and Hecate returns!
notes.notes:
The "Eye of the Beholder" event is back! 
Creatures from the depth of the oceans decided to pay a visit to the surface of Emporea!

The event lasts 6 days. Player’s job is to raid the event camps (and portals) in order to collect the event basic "currency": 4 kinds of Pearls, necessary for creating of a Pearl amulet - used for obtaining of all other event items and objects.

Pearl amulet can be crafted also at the Alchemist.


 Hecate game world returns! 
Welcome Sorcerer, to a realm where untamed magical energies run rampant and torrents of mana swirl across the starry sky. Welcome to the source of magic itself!

Hecate is a special server for experienced players. It is faster and it concentrates on magic. 

 How much “faster” is it? 
Hecate lasts only 28 days, which is 3,5 times less than all the regular servers. Moreover, most game actions are 3 times faster than on usual game worlds! 

 How does it “concentrate on Magic”? 
In Hecate magic skills are much more powerful, ALL spells are stronger and have unlimited range. Summoning spells conjure much more units and Magic pollution dissipates rapidly. Players collect Magic Essence - which serves as a crafting material for magical artifacts - and Magical Stones - which are used to research NEW spells. Moreover players start with a free mana totem.

 You can now register to the game world and it starts on May 12th, 2016 at 10:00 Emporea time. 


 Changes made to the game world:  

The amount of Achievement Points necessary to access the game world has been lowered from 400 to 250.
Stealing of tears by attacking another player’s city has been turned off.
These artifacts have been modified for this game world: Silver boots, Ignis, Magic collar, Generals wand, Necronomicon, Marjorie's Jewel.
There will be no drops of Spell range potions.
Dealing damage to the boss will now be harder than in the previous version of the game world.
You can now boost your spells before casting them by using Double damage. For using extra mana, the damage of the spell increases 2x.



 Other changes and improvements in the game:  

Players are now able to change the pictures of their avatar from their mobile devices.
Minor changes to the Mass Attack windows.
Researching new spells at the Magic Laboratory has been slightly changed. You can now do extractions from runes at different levels of the Magic Laboratory:

     Extraction of Light (I runes) - Level 1 of Magic Laboratory
     Extraction of Earth (II runes) - Level 4 of Magic Laboratory
     Extraction of Water (III runes) - Level 8 of Magic Laboratory
     Extraction of Fire (IV runes) - Level 12 of Magic Laboratory
     Extraction of Air (V runes) - Level 16 of Magic Laboratory

We added 9 brand new Steam Cards, 5 wallpapers, 5 badges (plus one legendary) and 5 emoticons to Emporea on Steam! 
Other minor changes and improvements.

notes.title: PATCH 4.58 is here!
notes.notes:
"Sands of Oblivion" Event is back!

There are Ifrits, Djinns and Magical lamps in Emporea! Also, a great part of the world map gets covered by sand tiles and palm trees. (Therefore we can assume that long drinks and beach bars are somewhere to be found too).

The event lasts for 6 days. Players' job is to earn "Points" by raiding the event camps, sending alchemist ingredients & with friendly buildings speed-ups in order to collect "Magical lamp." (1000 Points = 1 Magical lamp).

The Magical lamp is the event basic "currency", necessary for obtaining other event items and objects (artifacts, units, spell) in the event Shop.

Ifrits cost mana. They can be bought for 400 mana each in the event Shop, but only during the event. 

Changes made to the event:

The legendary artifact Eye of terror from the “Return of the Fire Dragon” event has also been added to this one. These are the features of the artifact: 

Experience bonus +6 % (+4 % with each additional level)
Artifact discovery +6 % (+5 % with each additional level)
Raided resources +5 % (+3 % with each additional level)


Other changes and improvements: 

Separate icons have been added to the Messages window, distinguishing alliance messages from player messages. 

The amount of troops created with Flamekin necromancy is now visible in the battle reports.

A button for upgrading the Altar of the Gods has been added to the Alliance window for the players that have the right to do so and when the alliance has enough resources and Tears of Gods for an upgrade.

Other minor graphic changes and bug fixes.

notes.title: PATCH 4.56 is here!
notes.notes:
The "Death from the Skies" event is back! 
Finally, there are Dragons in Emporea! 

The event lasts 6 days. Player’s job is to raid the event camps in order to look for "Dragon chests". Dragon chests contain many treasures, including 4 kinds of Ice coin parts. One of each kind is needed to create an Ice coin in the Forge. The Ice coin is the event basic "currency", necessary for obtaining of other event items and objects (artifacts, units, spell) in the event Shop.

Dragon chests can also contain one of 4 parts of the Frozen heart. One of each kind is needed to create a Frozen heart in the Forge. It is an item used for summoning of the powerful dragon Frostbane! 

 Changes and improvements: 
 When looking for new members, you can check the “Looking for members” option in the Alliance window. If this option is checked, all players who send a request to your alliance will be automatically added. You can also look for new members by pressing the “Players looking for alliance” button and filter the players by their nationality.

 A notification is shown after using a spell on a city which has an active Magic Shield.

 The cooldown of the Recall spell has been lowered from 14400 to 1200 seconds and each new level lowers it by 90 seconds. 

 A information in the global inventory has been added to the Reward chest which is gained after a game world ends, indicating from which game world it came from. 

 The design of water has been changed.

 The amount of stolen / lost Tears of the Gods has been added to the battle notifications.

 Before casting a spell, the amount of Magic Cloud on target is shown in the Spells window.

 The icons of several spells have been slightly changed.

 Several other changes and minor bug fixes.


We would love to get feedback from you (in the Steam discussions, on our Forum, Facebook or via our Support) and please also rate our game here on Steam.

Have fun with the event!

Best regards,
Emporea Team
